name: io.github.holistis/capacity-attest
description: Signed delivery claims for x402 capacity trades: GPU-hours, storage, API credits, bandwidth.

environmentVariables.description: Directory the append-only claims ledger (claims.jsonl) is written to and read from. Defaults to ./data inside the package.
environmentVariables.name: CAPACITY_ATTEST_DATA_DIR

fiscalControls.about: Static, pre-connection fiscal-safety metadata (spend caps, signer isolation/custody, audit trail) for the SEPARATE, operator-run capacity-attest-http binary (src/http-server.ts) -- NOT for the npx/stdio package declared in `packages` above, whose record_delivery is always unpaid and holds no signer. Even in the HTTP binary these controls only activate once an operator sets RECORD_DELIVERY_PAY_TO; unset, record_delivery stays unpaid there too. See modelcontextprotocol/registry discussion #1300. wellKnownPath resolves against that operator's own deployed origin -- this server.json does not declare one (no `remotes` entry), so none is canonical.
